exclude_titles: How Much Does a Bookkeeper Cost in Melbourne? (2026 Guide)

client_facts.about: Made-up demo client. Harbourline Bookkeeping is a Melbourne bookkeeping firm for small businesses and sole traders, founded 2017, team of 9, office in Richmond, serves all of metro Melbourne remotely and on-site.
services: BAS preparation and lodgement (via registered BAS agent)
credentials: registered BAS agent with the Tax Practitioners Board
member of the Institute of Certified Bookkeepers (ICB)
client_facts.pricing: fixed monthly packages from $290/month; catch-up work quoted as a fixed fee; free quotes
client_facts.first_hand_notes: Client-supplied: Dana, owner of a two-location café in Fitzroy, has used Harbourline since 2022. Before: 9 months of unreconciled Xero, late BAS. Harbourline did a fixed-fee catch-up in 3 weeks, moved payroll to STP, now sends a one-page monthly report by the 10th. Dana says the biggest change was knowing cash position weekly. Downsides she mentions: no tax return service, so she still uses a separate accountant; onboarding needed two weeks of receipts sorting on her side.
